prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game player dancing spritesheet, six isolated animation frames.
Primary request: generate a player dancing spritesheet on tile.

Input image: the sole supplied raster is an authored SVG geometry and pose guide. Its six square floors establish the per-frame scale and ground position. Its sparse stick poses establish posture only; invent the finished character, anatomy, outfit, face, and expressive details. Do not reproduce the guide strokes.

Scene/backdrop: six separate panels on a transparent canvas. Each panel has one flat plain screen-aligned green square, exactly RGB 123,209,75, without rim, thickness, texture, pale corner marks, gradient, cast shadow or perspective. Keep that square intact and visible around the feet. The square is a removable calibration substrate.

Subject/style: one distinctive cheerful game player with warm skin, short dark hair, a coral-red casual jacket, cream shirt, dark navy trousers and light sneakers. Clean polished 2D game illustration with clear outlines, readable shapes and modest soft shading. Keep character identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, palette, proportions, apparent scale, camera and lighting consistent in all six frames. Keep all character parts clear of the reserved green floor hue.

Composition: exactly three columns by two rows in row-major order, preserving the reference's 640:672 canvas aspect. Aim for a 1600 by 1680 pixel output or an equivalent proportional canvas. In reference coordinates each panel is 192 by 320; columns begin at x=0,224,448 and rows at y=0,352. The 32px strips between panels must remain genuinely alpha transparent. In every panel the calibration square occupies x=32..160 and y=184..312, relative to that panel. Its center at x=96,y=248 is the character's fixed projected ground location. Shoe toes may extend below the center, but the ground location stays fixed. Do not enlarge, tilt, warp or relocate the green squares.

Motion: follow the six distinct stick poses in the reference, with believable dancing limbs and visible pose progression: arms bent outward; sway left with left arm raised; sway right with right arm raised; both arms raised; left hip sway with one arm up and the other lowered; mirrored right hip sway. The knees, torso lean and hands should visibly change while the feet remain located around the same floor-center point.

Constraints: full head, hair, hands, arms, legs and shoes remain inside each panel with ample margins. Keep panels completely isolated; no art, shadows, floor, glow, particles or effects may cross a gutter or touch any canvas edge. Outside character and green square use real alpha transparency, never white/black fill or a painted checkerboard. No labels, text, grid lines, borders, scenery, extra characters, props, watermark or visible skeleton guide. Deliver the complete six-frame sheet in one image.
userRequest: generate a player dancing spritesheet on tile
